query:
WITH k AS 
            (
                INSERT INTO kennelings
                    (
                        kennel_id,
                        author_id,
                        victim_id,
                        kennel_length,
                        msg_announce_id,
                        kennel_msg_id
                    )
                VALUES
                    (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4,
                        $5,
                        $6
                    )
                RETURNING *
            )
            SELECT 
                k.id,
                k.kennel_id,
                k.author_id,
                k.victim_id,
                k.kenneled_at,
                k.kennel_length,
                k.released_at,
                k.msg_announce_id,
                k.kennel_msg_id,
                a.channel_id as msg_announce_channel_id,
                b.channel_id as kennel_msg_channel_id
            FROM k
            LEFT JOIN sent_messages a
            ON
                a.message_id = k.msg_announce_id
            LEFT JOIN sent_messages b
            ON
                b.message_id = k.kennel_msg_id
                ;
